about: The Concourse's premade characters (dungeon/campaign.py): the two of the four from Halvorsen's who came down at the Waystone. Base Prospero sheets at creation, from Vanta's Mabry Curve archive (world/packages/babel/personas.json).

premades.name: Grant Mabry
premades.about: Lead systems engineer on BABEL, the full-dive game the tower is now wearing, pulled out of his own launch party with a ring in his pocket. He knows every curve and rank table by heart and is about to learn which of them the tower kept. The rebuild froze partway through him: his race reads unstable, his class reads garbled, and every joint aches in a way regeneration will not touch. His fiancee came down three floors up, with his best friend.

premades.name: Kenzie Cole
premades.about: Bri's younger sister, a college junior who came to the party for the open bar and saw too much at the coat check minutes before the lights went. She asked the tower for a beast lineage and got a golden one she did not ask for; her tattoos and piercings did not make the trip. Funny, sharp and loyal to Grant in a way she has not looked at closely, carrying two secrets that are not hers to tell.
